new_value: store_rx_floor now pre-checks catalog capacity and anchor liveness BEFORE _write_to_older_slot_locked: a new origin at catalog capacity, or a catalog whose anchored revision cannot be validated (lost/rotated anchor), fails deterministically with no slot artifacts written, instead of the old indeterminate post-commit failure. _MAX_RX_CATALOG_ENTRIES raised 512 -> 10000, aligned with the _MAX_TRUST_ENTRIES=10000 pin-table budget in key_persistence.py (the _RX_CATALOG_MAX_SIZE formula scales automatically). store_rx_floor contract now documents the commit order, the deterministic pre-check failures, and the residual ENOSPC/anchor-CAS indeterminate window after the slot commit (committed floor stays effective; loads heal the catalog from it or fail closed preserving the floor; no replay window re-opens). New tests: capacity pre-check rejects before slot commit while existing origins keep updating at capacity; anchor-liveness pre-check rejects before slot commit; both verified to fail against the old code via temporary revert. Existing 512-entry catalogs remain valid under the raised cap.
